# Examples

```{=latex}
\clearpage
% The overview table (_table_pdf.qmd, generated by example_table.py) is set
% on A3 landscape pages. They are left out of the page numbering: the page
% counter is saved here and restored afterwards.
\newcounter{savepage}
\setcounter{savepage}{\value{page}}
\pagenumbering{gobble}
% The paper size of the PDF pages, and the layout geometry computes the text
% area from, so that the table gets 396 x 273 mm. Both are put back below.
\edef\olbSavedPaper{%
  \pdfpagewidth=\the\pdfpagewidth \pdfpageheight=\the\pdfpageheight
  \paperwidth=\the\paperwidth \paperheight=\the\paperheight}
\pdfpagewidth=420mm \pdfpageheight=297mm
\paperwidth=420mm \paperheight=297mm
\newgeometry{layoutwidth=420mm, layoutheight=297mm, margin=12mm}
```

{{< include _table_pdf.qmd >}}

```{=latex}
\restoregeometry
\olbSavedPaper
% \pagenumbering resets the counter, so it is set afterwards. savepage was
% taken after \clearpage and already holds the number of the next page.
\pagenumbering{arabic}
\setcounter{page}{\value{savepage}}
```
